::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Lam's first India manufacturing facility (vs. its existing Bengaluru R&D-only India Center for Engineering) — positions India as a silicon-component manufacturing and export base for Lam's global operations, not just a service/engineering hub. Exact facility site not disclosed at announcement; location given here is Lam's existing Bengaluru base and should be confirmed once a specific site is announced.
:::

## What does this facility supply?

Silicon ingot production and processing components for advanced/leading-edge semiconductor process equipment; also funds R&D expansion and training up to 60,000 students via IISc and ISM partnerships.

## Project Timeline

- **17 Sep 2026** — Lam Research announces ₹10,000cr investment for India's first silicon component manufacturing facility, at SEMICON India 2026
